mathematical_inputs.hilbert_space: Declared history L2 space at fixed terminal clock; sectorwise or full direct sum must be specified.
mathematical_inputs.phase: Declared multiplication D=exp(iS); no dynamics derivation implied.
mathematical_inputs.target_effect: Known rank-one projector E=|phi><phi|; failure effect I-E retained.
mathematical_inputs.classical_law: Full joint lambda_phi=|phi|^2 nu; baseline lambda_ref fixed independently.
mathematical_inputs.instrument: Luders E and I-E only as explicit reference; another update is a different instrument.

representation_rule.map: Unitary U:H_theta->H_0 from the equivalent measures
representation_rule.probabilities: Invariant when all objects are transported

calibration.epsilon: Upper bound on 1-Tr(E_actual rho), not supplied by the algebra.
calibration.delta: Total variation of complete joint record law versus declared reference.

physical_evidence_required.evidence: CST physical state space, inner product and applicable constraints/symmetries supporting the declared states.
Physical preparation or cosmological boundary law producing rho without outcome-dependent fitting.
Derivation or operational determination of the complete joint law, including number weights if used.
Specified allowed matter/geometry/pointer coupling, causal support and physical derivation of its rank-one effect or bounded approximation.
Justification of the full instrument for any sequential claim, including success/failure records.
Independent bounds epsilon, tau and delta with their actual confidence/coverage conditions.
Consistent detector/preparation backreaction when claiming gravitational dynamics.

decision: Until these physical requirements are met, report only conditional reference predictions; improving n=5 quadrature cannot establish the selection law.
